title: Cheesy Potato-Broccoli-Mushroom Bake
description: Baby potatoes, broccoli and raw mushrooms under a smooth half-and-half and cream cheese sauce, assembled early in the day and baked bubbly at 425°F.

ingredients.name: smoked paprika or a pinch of your favorite BBQ rub

steps.title: Cook potatoes
steps.text: Microwave {potatoes} for 5 to 6 minutes until just tender.

steps.title: Soften broccoli
steps.text: Microwave or steam {broccoli} for 2 minutes to soften slightly.

steps.title: Assemble veggies
steps.text: Add the potatoes, broccoli and raw {mushrooms} to a baking dish.

steps.title: Start sauce
steps.text: Warm {halfhalf} in a small pot over low heat.
Add {velveeta} and stir until fully melted.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season the sauce with {grangarlic}, {granonion}, {salt}, {pepper} and optional {paprika}.

steps.title: Check texture
steps.text: The sauce should be pourable but slightly thick. Add a splash more half-and-half if it is too thick.

steps.title: Chill ahead
steps.text: Let the sauce cool slightly, pour it over the veggies, cover, and refrigerate until ready to bake.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Uncover the dish and bake at 425°F for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned.
Optional: broil for 1 to 2 minutes for extra color.

notes: Everything except the bake can be done early in the day. The potatoes and broccoli are only partly cooked so they finish in the oven without going mushy.
